Under the sea, we’re spilling the tea with Jodi Benson 🐠🫖 #Disneyland #TeacupConfessions
Disney Legend Jodi Benson joins Teacup Confessions for a rapid-fire round of Disney and Broadway questions on Mad Tea Party at Disneyland Park! ☕🏰

Jodi Benson is best known for voicing Ariel in The Little Mermaid. She was also the voice of Barbie in Pixar’s Toy Story 2 and Toy Story 3, Helen of Troy in the Hercules television series, and Weebo the flying robot in Flubber. Jodi made her live-action movie debut in Disney’s Enchanted. 

Jodi shares:
🗣️ Which Ariel line she's asked to say most often
🧑‍🩰 If she prefers voice acting or performing live
📞 Where she learned she'd be a Disney Legend
🎡 What Ariel's favorite Disneyland Resort ride would be
🎭 Favorite Broadway memory
👜 If she prefers gadgets or gizmos
🧜‍♀️ What color her mermaid tail would be
🐭 Favorite Disneyland memory
🤩 What is was like meeting Halle Bailey 
🦄 Why fairytales continue to matter
🥸 Biggest myth making a living as an Actor
😡 Which Disney Villain is most misunderstood
and more!

#JodiBenson #Disneyland #DisneyParks #TeacupConfessions #DisneyLegend
